content: The art of living does not consist in careless drifting on the one hand or in fearful clinging on the other. It consists in being sensitive to each moment.
author: Alan Watts
story:
A former Anglican priest who immersed himself in Eastern philosophy, Alan Watts became a pioneering voice in mid-century California, bridging Taoism, Vedanta, and Zen with Western psychology. Confronting the frantic anxieties of modern consumerism and mechanistic materialism, Watts illuminated the illusion of the separate ego, inviting people to realize they are the entire cosmos experiencing itself.

In formulating this reflection, Alan Watts stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of art of living. For Alan Watts, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
